text.name: Rwandan Genocide
text.rules: Record "the world looks away". If "intervention fatigue" has been recorded this game, until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 2 fewer and each time SAE spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1; otherwise, until the end of this turn, each time either side spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1.
text.history: Between April and July 1994 an estimated 500,000 to 800,000 people, mostly Tutsi, were killed in Rwanda; the radio station RTLM, broadcasting from July 1993, incited the killings.
